_readme: No keys or RPC URLs with API keys belong in this file. 'verified' notes say how each address was checked (rpc = on-chain read on 2026-10-01; web = cited page; repo = repo test config). Omitted keys are unknown and read as address(0) by the deploy scripts; see 'todo'.
name: base

weth.verified: rpc: symbol WETH, 18 dec; OP-stack predeploy

mln.verified: rpc: symbol MLN, 18 dec; but no Chainlink MLN feed (repo BASE_MLN_ETH_AGGREGATOR is TODO) so MLN is not registered as a primitive

release.chainlinkStaleRateThresholdNote: 172800s (48h) sized for the SLOWEST registered feed. Slowest = USDC/USD: heartbeat 86400s, max observed gap 86490s (it updates at ~heartbeat+30..90s, so a threshold only just above the heartbeat reverts whenever an update is a little late). 172800 = 2x heartbeat tolerates one fully missed update. Base ETH/USD: heartbeat UNVERIFIED (not in the Chainlink directory); observed max gap 1232s over 300 rounds, far inside the threshold, but if Chainlink's real heartbeat were longer than 48h valuation would revert (fails closed). Trade-off: too LOW reverts valid rates and freezes the vault; too HIGH accepts stale prices (up to 48h for ETH/USD because the threshold is global). Values re-checked 2026-10-01.

gasRelay.verified: repo config leaves hub/forwarder as address(0) TODO on Base; gas relay disabled
